$comment: Projectiles (ruleset v0; spec S2 section 6.1, settled 2026-11-07; numbers are proposals). Range on flat ground in calm air; flight time scales with distance; windPermillePerMPerS of range per m/s of wind along the shot, clamped; heightGainPerMm of range per mm the shooter stands above the target, capped; hit chance near (up to the close share of range) falling linearly to far; damage before the target's arrowTakenPermille; reload and ammunition per regiment volley. The crossbow bolt and siege stone join with their users (M5 item 6).
